hero.title: Software and digital products
hero.say: From an idea to a working product. I study your idea with you, then build your product, website, online shop or system step by step, and stay with you after launch.

door.title: Software and digital products
door.say: From an idea to a working product.

problems.question: Afraid to spend on an idea before you know it will work?
problems.why: The big losses start when you build before you ask.
problems.fix: I assess your idea and its technical feasibility, analyse what your business and product need, plan the product and its architecture, then build a prototype you can try and a first product you test with real customers.
problems.name: From idea to product

problems.question: Your website doesn’t present you as you deserve, or you don’t have one at all?
problems.why: A customer looks you up before calling you, and what they find decides for them.
problems.fix: I build personal and professional websites, sites for companies and businesses, sites for doctors, lawyers, consultants and professionals, and landing pages and corporate sites, with a dashboard where you manage your own content.
includes: Websites for doctors, lawyers, consultants and professionals
Custom dashboards and content management systems
problems.name: Websites

problems.question: You sell in messages, and orders get lost between chats?
problems.why: A notebook and scattered messages don’t grow with your sales.
problems.fix: I build an online shop made to fit your work: product and stock management, an order and payment system, customer management, and links to shipping companies and other services.
includes: Shipping and links to other services
problems.name: Online shops

problems.question: Your work runs on paper and spreadsheets?
problems.why: Spreadsheets, paper and scattered messages don’t grow with your business.
problems.fix: I build custom web applications, business management systems, internal platforms for your organisation, CRM and operations systems, and SaaS products, with their back end, APIs and database connections, and stay with you to develop and maintain them.
includes: Back-end systems, APIs and database connections
problems.name: Custom systems and software

goal: I don’t start with a line of code.
I start with a question: does your idea deserve to be built?
